title: ORDER BY DESC on dates puts BLANK after every date
query: EVALUATE Dates ORDER BY Dates[D] DESC

source.quote: the integer corresponds to the number of days since December 30, 1899, and the decimal part identifies the fraction of the day
source.supports: dates order as their numbers do: later dates and later times are larger

source.quote: treat BLANK as equal to number 0, empty string "", DATE(1899, 12, 30), or FALSE
source.supports: next to a date, BLANK compares as 1899-12-30, earlier than every date in the column

derivation: Dates[D] by Id: 2024-03-01 (1), BLANK (2), 2023-12-31 (3), 2024-01-05 13:00 (4). Descending: 2024-03-01, 2024-01-05 13:00, 2023-12-31. BLANK is below all of them whether it sorts as the lowest value or as 1899-12-30, so it is last under either reading: Ids 1, 4, 3, 2.
